name: Cybat Intelligence Engine
tagline: Real-time AI threat intelligence, JA4 fingerprinting, and behavioral API security with 0 ms origin latency.
description: Protect your APIs and web applications with autonomous AI threat detection. The Cybat Edge Collector intercepts HTTP/HTTPS traffic at Cloudflare's edge, extracts behavioral signals and JA4 fingerprints, scrubs sensitive credentials in memory, and asynchronously dispatches telemetry to your Cybat tenant out-of-band.

bindings.name: CYBAT_API_KEY
bindings.description: Organization API key obtained from your Cybat Intelligence Dashboard (https://app.cybat.co).

bindings.name: PROJECT_ID
bindings.description: Project identifier used to segment telemetry and security rules inside Cybat.

bindings.name: CYBAT_MAX_BODY_BYTES
bindings.description: Maximum payload extraction ceiling in bytes (default 64 KB).
